title: Collection of Change-Order Charges with the Replacement System Installations Progress Installment
content:
# Change-order charges collected in full with the progress installment

## Rule

The change-order collection of a Replacement System Installations progress installment follows the change-order approvals the homeowner has confirmed on the project:

- with 3 or more confirmed approvals, every change-order charge on the project is collected in full with the progress installment instead of at the progress share;
- with exactly 2 confirmed approvals, the change-order charge carrying the highest change-order number, which is the most recently approved one, is collected in full, and the others stay at the progress share;
- with fewer, every change-order charge stays at the progress share.

A charge collected in full is taken out of the progress base and collected at its whole amount.

## Records read

- **Confirmed approvals:** change-order approval requests on the project in confirmed status.
- **Change-order charges:** change-order charge entries on the project ledger, each carrying its change-order number.

## Input — judgement — output

| Confirmed change-order approvals | Collected in full | Left at the progress share |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | Every change-order charge | None |
| Exactly 2 | The change-order charge with the highest number | The other change-order charges |
| 1 or none | None | Every change-order charge |

## Cases (hypothetical projects)

- Two confirmed approvals; change orders number 1 ($420.00) and number 2 ($895.00) charged: $895.00 is collected in full; $420.00 stays at the progress share.
- Three confirmed approvals with charges of $300.00, $420.00 and $895.00: all $1615.00 is collected in full.
- One confirmed approval with a $420.00 charge: the $420.00 stays at the progress share.
